name: Modern Nade Ali Calligraphy
short_desc: Make a vibrant mid-century statement with this hand-painted Nade Ali calligraphy piece. Featuring sweeping black brushstrokes on a warm mustard-yellow textured background with a gloss varnish seal, it brings modern artistic energy to living rooms and studies.
seo_title: Mid-Century Modern Nade Ali Calligraphy – Hand-Painted Ochre Yellow Acrylic Wall Art
description:
Add expressive modern flair to your home decor with this striking hand-painted Islamic art piece. The canvas showcases the revered Nade Ali prayer, featuring prominent, sweeping black script that flows dynamically across the upper composition.

Hand-painted using high-quality acrylic paints, the background is a rich, warm mustard ochre yellow with subtle stippled texturing that gives the piece depth and character. The bold contrast between the deep black ink and the radiant yellow tone creates a commanding visual focal point.

A protective gloss varnish coat seals the artwork, guarding against dust and UV rays while highlighting the texture of the acrylic paint under ambient lighting.

Framed in a clean, dark walnut frame, this artwork pairs beautifully with mid-century modern furniture, olive green accents, teak wood, and contemporary minimalist decor.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish seal for color longevity and gloss finish

Theme & Script: Nade Ali prayer in expressive modern composition

Color Palette: Textured mustard ochre yellow background with rich black script

Style: Mid-Century Modern / Contemporary Calligraphic Art

Ideal Placement: Living room, home office, lounge feature wall, or hallway gallery
